data.name: The Corn Maze: Rebirth
data.detailed_description:
"The Corn Maze: Rebirth" is a solo-developed survival horror experience set in a vast, twisting corn maze. You weren’t forced here — you were invited. Why you accepted is unclear… but once inside, it’s obvious this place is not what it seemed.

You’re not the first to be dropped here… and you won’t be the last.

As you navigate the labyrinth, you’ll find hand-written notes from someone only known through scrawled warnings and veiled advice. This figure is guiding you from the shadows, and these fragments slowly reveal the truth about why you were chosen, and what secret force lurks behind this place.

Strange markings and portals to unknown sections of the maze suggest this place is part experiment, part ritual.

These cryptic messages hint at something bigger: a hidden group known only in fragments, whose influence reaches far beyond the maze. You were brought here for a reason. Not to be toyed with — but to be erased.

You’re not alone. Something — or someone — is watching. The maze is full of unnatural threats: creatures that stalk the corn and feed ravenously.

The deeper you go, the more the lines blur between science and magic, survival and manipulation, faith and control. Survival demands caution, exploration, and problem-solving under pressure. Resources are scarce. And escape isn’t just about finding the exit — it’s about unraveling why you’re a target at all.

The game blends first-person shooting, limited-resource combat, survival horror, and light puzzle elements. Ammo is limited. Battery packs are rare. Portals to other levels of the maze twist space and time, each bringing you closer to a truth you may not be ready for.

Every decision matters, and every corner could be your last.

And while many wish you harm… one unseen figure seems determined to keep you alive. But why?

Key Features

  • Explore a sprawling, multi-layered corn maze filled with tension, darkness, and secrets

  • Survive deadly encounters using limited firearms and a dwindling flashlight powered by battery packs

  • Piece together the truth through scattered notes and world details left by a mysterious helper

  • Discover hidden portals that lead to new, surreal levels of the maze, each with new threats and secrets

  • Progress through blocked paths and continually uncover lore

  • Face multiple unique monsters, each with distinct behavior, strengths, and weaknesses

  • Survive against a backdrop of dark cult-like ideologies through cryptic symbols, strange shrines, and unexplainable rituals and a hidden enemy pulling the strings

  • Engage with multiple game modes, including variations that offer new ways to challenge yourself

  • Question who to trust, as a mysterious figure helps from the shadows…

Themes & Style

  • "The Corn Maze: Rebirth" is a high-tension survival horror experience where you’re not just exploring — you’re being hunted. Every shadow could hide something dangerous, and every bullet counts. It’s not just about staying alive — it’s about uncovering why you're being hunted in the first place.

  • Moments of sudden violence — monsters, disorientation, and jump scares — erupt against a backdrop of constant dread and paranoia. The game weaves together supernatural phenomena, cult-like rituals, and fragmented lore to build a world where science and belief collide.

  • Themes of secrecy, manipulation, and unseen control run deep — and as you press forward, you’ll question not just your survival, but your purpose.

  • Not just one threat — multiple monsters roam the mazes, each bringing their own unique terror

  • You're not alone: a mysterious hero figure seems to be trying to help you — but who are they really?

data.short_description: Trapped in a massive corn maze, you must survive monstrous threats, uncover hidden truths, and follow cryptic notes from a mysterious figure. Shoot, scavenge, and explore twisted portals as you unravel a dark conspiracy blending science, cults, and control.

  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio

content_descriptors.notes:
Significant fantasy violence involving monstrous entities and firearm combat. Includes blood, gore, and disturbing imagery such as body horror and dismembered remains. The game features survival horror elements like limited resources and constant threat of attack. Psychological horror themes include ritualistic cult activity, implied human experimentation, and unsettling audio/visuals.

Not suitable for children or those sensitive to horror themes.
